 Garudayaksa FC was defeated by Persib Bandung
 25th October 2026 22:38 GMT+7
 Garudayaksa FC footballer Wahyu Prasetyo (left) competes for the ball with Persib Bandung footballer Uiliam Baros (right) during the Liga 1 match at Gelora Pakansari Stadium, Bogor Regency, West Java, Sunday (25/10/2026). Garudayaksa FC was defeated by Persib Bandung with a score of 1-2. ANTARA FOTO/Yulius Satria Wijaya/hma
